title: NuAire LabGard Class II A2 BSC
manualMd: Class II Type A2 biosafety cabinet for BSL-2 work. Provides product, personnel, and environmental protection through HEPA-filtered downflow and exhaust. Annual certification required.
hazardsMd:
- The BSC is NOT a fume hood. Do not work with volatile chemicals inside it (no large-volume ethanol bursts, no formaldehyde).
- Sash must stay at the working height marker; raising it breaks containment.
- Annual certification expires; if the sticker is past-due, do not use.

operations.title: Daily startup
operations.bodyMd:
1. Confirm certification sticker is current.
2. Power on UV (15 min); then turn UV off and power on blowers + work-surface light.
3. Wait 5 min for airflow to stabilize.
4. Wipe the work surface, side walls, and inside of the sash with 70% ethanol — top to bottom, back to front.

operations.title: Loading the BSC
operations.bodyMd: Bring in only what you need. Pre-spray every item with 70% ethanol. Place clean items on the left, dirty/waste on the right. Keep the airflow grilles unobstructed at the front and back.

operations.title: Airflow alarm
operations.bodyMd: Stop work immediately. Don't open the sash further. Step away. Common causes: blocked grille, sash wrong height, exhaust blower failure. Tag out and contact the lab manager.

operations.title: Spill inside the BSC
operations.bodyMd: Leave the blower running. Cover with disinfectant-soaked towel for 20 min. Clean from clean to dirty. Decon the entire surface afterward; for >5 mL spills, decon the catch basin under the work surface.

operations.title: Post-use
operations.bodyMd:
1. Decon all surfaces with 70% ethanol.
2. Remove all materials.
3. Run blowers for 5 min more to clear the workspace.
4. Power off blowers + light; turn UV on for end-of-day decon (if your lab's protocol uses UV).
